items.title: JJ Johnson — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: I called him recently to tell him that we were going to record one of his little-known compositions, a lovely ballad called People Time, with [Robert] Farnon, on the Farnon thing that's coming up soon.

ctx.x: Do you still keep up with each other?

We talk once in a while. I called him recently to tell him that we were going to record one of his little-known compositions, a lovely ballad called People Time, with [Robert] Farnon, on the Farnon thing that's coming up soon. [This was released on the CD Tangence.] He was very pleased. I told Benny that I was having trouble getting a bona fide lead sheet on The Meaning of the Blues. He said, "Oh! Bobby Troup.
